column1: # comment: Location alignments for comprehensive geo interop — schema.org, GeoSPARQL, GeoNames, Getty (gvp), Wikidata, WGS84, vCard, BOT, ifcOWL. placeType/storageMedium are value individuals aligned (closeMatch) to external classes/feature-codes; address components align to schema.org + vCard for lossless round-trip; containedInPlace aligns to the topological "within"/parent relations of every geo vocab. StorageLocation/Location/storage* and authorityLink are canonical (no faithful external term). Coreference of place INSTANCES to gazetteer records is done in data with skos:exactMatch + gmeow:authorityLink (Wikidata as hub), not here. Added (#96): Stream → sta:Datastream; LocationState → sta:HistoricalLocation + sosa:Sample; Trajectory → sta:Datastream. Added (#83): indoor realm bridging to BOT (Zone/Site/Building/Storey/Space, containsZone, adjacentZone) and ifcOWL (IfcBuilding/IfcBuildingStorey/IfcSpace/IfcSite) by reference.

column7: Wikidata P131 is the flat administrative-hierarchy property; GMEOW ContainmentTenure reifies it with temporal scope and standpoint indexing.
CIDOC-CRM E4_Period captures the time-spanned governance period; GMEOW JurisdictionTenure adds the place×polity relator structure and standpoint indexing.
CIDOC-CRM E92 Spacetime Volume — a 4D point set; GMEOW LocationState is a discrete slice (location + time + pose) of it
CRMgeo SP1 Spacetime Volume — the geospatial extension of CIDOC E92
A LocationState in a stream is a sample of the entity's trajectory.
HistoricalLocation is time-indexed location of a Thing; LocationState is the state of a moving entity at a time.
Brick Occupancy is a class for the current number of entities in a space; GMEOW Occupancy is a reified Measurement with location, scalar result, and provenance.
BOT Zone is a 3D spatial extent (physical or virtual); GMEOW Place is broader (includes outdoor, non-building geographic places), so the alignment is closeMatch rather than exact.
CIDOC-CRM E41_Appellation is the time-spanned name; GMEOW PlaceNaming is the reified relator (NameUsage) that binds a PlaceName to a Place over an interval.

schema.org AdministrativeArea is a flat Place subclass for government-defined areas; GMEOW RegulatoryOverlay is a reified, time-scoped situation that binds a place, an authority, a regulation type, and optional deontic rules. Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata Q1055894 is the general concept of an administrative territorial entity; GMEOW RegulatoryOverlay adds time-scoping, authority, regulation type, and deontic linkage.
SensorThings Datastream groups observations by sensor + observed property.
a Trajectory is a continuous spacetime volume (relatedMatch, not closeMatch — a trajectory is a path, not any arbitrary volume)
Trajectory as the continuous form of a stream; weaker alignment than Stream→Datastream.
Direct alignment: both gmeow:containsPlace and bot:containsZone represent parent→child containment.
schema.org maximumAttendeeCapacity is a flat integer property on Place/Event; GMEOW hasCapacity links to a reified Capacity Measurement. Directional lossy projection.

schema.org organizer is a loose match for the authority that imposed a regulatory overlay; GMEOW overlayAuthority is specifically the governing body (state, international organization, indigenous council) that decreed the regulation. Directional lossy projection.
schema.org legislation is a CreativeWork subclass for laws; GMEOW overlayRegulation links to a machine-readable RightsStatement (deontic rules). Directional lossy projection.

OWL-Time TimeZone is a temporal reference position; GMEOW overlayTypeCivilTimeZone adds the regulatory authority and time-scoped interval, treating the timezone as a government-decreed spatial overlay.
UNCLOS Article 55 defines the EEZ; GMEOW models it as a regulatory overlay with authority, time scope, and deontic rules. Maritime-specific depth bounds use overlayLowerBound / overlayUpperBound.
IUCN management categories (Ia–VI) are additional classifications on the protected area, not subclasses.
AIXM airspace types (prohibited, restricted, danger, TRA, TSA) are specific kinds of restricted airspace, aligned by reference in data via skos:exactMatch to the relevant AIXM code list values.
ifcOWL is reference-only; GMEOW models the concept and links by IRI without copying axioms.
